issues.title: Broken External Symbol Resolution
issues.why: The spec references 'apperror.Wrap', 'ErrSeedLoadFailed', and 'pathutil' which are explicitly delegated to spec/03 and other modules, but those modules are not provided in the context.
issues.fix: Provide the 'apperror' package definition and 'pathutil' source or mock signatures in the fundamentals file.

issues.title: Incomplete Concurrency Implementation Detail
issues.why: AC-SC-21 mandates a file lock before SQL transaction, but the Go implementation in 01-fundamentals.md does not show the locking logic, only the GORM transaction.
issues.fix: Add a 'Lock()' and 'Unlock()' call using a sentinel file to the Go ConfigService.SeedWithVersionCheck snippet.

issues.title: Ambiguous Type Mapping for 'select'
issues.why: The schema uses 'Type: select' but the Go struct 'SettingValue' uses a union of scalars; it's unclear if 'select' should map to StringVal or a specific enum type in Go.
issues.fix: Explicitly state in the SettingValue struct comment that 'select' maps to StringVal and 'multiselect' maps to StringsVal.
